title: Analysis code: mitochondrial L2 haplogroup and HIV disease progression in Ugandan children
description: R code reproducing the tables, figures and statistical analyses of a study of mitochondrial haplogroups and time to HIV disease progression in a pediatric cohort from Uganda and Botswana (CAfGEN). Participant-level data are not included; see the repository README for data availability.
